newsitem.title: UK: Lehman appoints head of French fixed income.
newsitem.headline: Lehman appoints head of French fixed income.

text.p: Lehman Brothers said on Thursday it had appointed Nicolas Pourcelet as general manager of its French fixed income business.
"Based at the firm's Paris office, Pourcelet will be responsible for the sales and trading of fixed income products," Lehman said in a statement.
Lehman said Pourcelet would report to Leopold Jeorger, chairman Banque Lehman Brothers and Chris Deuters, managing director and head of European fixed income.
Pourcelet will replace Benoit d'Angelin who will assume broader responsibilities including heading European government bond sale at Lehman Brothers in London, the bank said.
"Pourcelet...has worked for Lehman Brothers for over six years, and prior to his return to Paris was head of fixed income sales for France and the Benelux and Scandinavian countries," Lehman said.
